fields.value: Hear-and-Avoid: Acoustic Detection of General Aviation Aircraft for UAV

dsDescriptionValue.value: This dataset consists of audio recordings of overflying general aviation propeller aircraft which overfly the microphone array. The data is labeled to identify where the plane overflies the microphone.

publicationCitation.value: D. Wijnker, T. van Dijk, M. Snellen, G. C. H. E. de Croon, and C. D. Wagter, “Hear and avoid for UAVs using convolutional neural networks,” in 11th international micro air vehicle competition and conference, Madrid, Spain, 2019, p. 144–156

datasetVersion.citation: Wijnker, Dirk; van Dijk, Tom; Snellen, Mirjam; de Croon, Guido; De Wagter, Christophe, 2020, "Hear-and-Avoid: Acoustic Detection of General Aviation Aircraft for UAV", https://doi.org/10.34894/ARULTD, DataverseNL, V1
